cross_repo_role: SDK side of gts-guideline-agent issue #22 (Publish to comand for annotators). Consumes the existing, unchanged gts-comand annotations contract (verified at 8d64a64a); ③ integrates by calling client.annotations().push_graph(...) with the create.graph payload it already builds for the ontology sandbox.
description: Add AgencyAnnotationsClient (/api/annotations) + AgencyClient.annotations() so an agent can publish a rule graph as annotation jobs. Covers the two-step control-plane flow — create_batch (POST /_command, CommandResponse envelope, DRAFT) then upload_graph (multipart 'file', one job per vertex matching target_class, batch flips to ACTIVE) — plus get_batch/list_batches read-back (the upload's response body is null), the /api/annotation-specs create/get/list needed to seed a job_type's checklist, and push_graph, the one-call create->upload->read-back convenience that is ③'s integration point. Graph input accepted as a dict or a file path. Ends by publishing 0.0.1rc14.
